title: Tenma Saki — Appreciation Overflow!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Let's see... Movies, movies...
Oh, this one looks pretty good!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, I'm adding it to my backlog!
se_walk_women_003_1

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Saki, are you by yourself?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hi, Ichi!
Shiho said to start without her because she needs to ask one of the teachers a question.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay. Honami also said she's going to be running late, so why don't we get started?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm starved.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. But I'm sorry for making you wait...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, that's okay. I was just looking up... Wait a second!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ichi, that reminds me.
Are there any movies you've been meaning to watch lately?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Movies?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Remember how we got to ask Kanade about songwriting?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, when we went to that cafe?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I asked her where the inspiration for her songs comes from...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Remember how movies, manga and works of art are the sources of some of her ideas?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. She makes a habit of taking in all kinds of works to enhance her music.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, is that why you asked me about movies...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. Correct!
I read manga on a regular basis already, so that just leaves movies and art.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm not ready right this second to visit an art museum, so I thought I could start with some movies first.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That makes sense. And you stand to learn a lot.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe♪ I was thinking about going to see something after school since we don't have practice today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: In that case, can I go with you?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I thought I should take this opportunity to also start exposing myself to more things.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ichi...!
Yeah, let's go together♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, while we're at it, we should also invite Shiho and Hona!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Right.
I'm looking forward to discussing what we saw afterwards.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. Now I'm even more excited!
Which movie should we see?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: There's “The Shape of the World”, but also “Attack of the Mecha-Zombies!”...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I haven't heard of either.
What are they about?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, “The Shape of the World” is a documentary that discusses some of society's problems.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's a documentary?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! The other one is a horror film about mechanized zombies.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But it apparently isn't scary at all. It's become a cult hit because of how the story's a mystery wrapped in an enigma that's full of twists and turns!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: R-Really...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I have to say, I'm surprised by your choices, Saki.
These aren't the kind of movies you'd normally go to see.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha. I'd usually pick a glamorous coming-of-age film or something...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I thought I should start trying a bunch of different genres, since my goal here is to experience new things!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Different genres?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Genres that I'm not really into or would avoid normally.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I figure I might find some unexpected new favorites that way!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I see...
I do agree with that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. See what I mean?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What's up?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I understand your desire to step outside your comfort zone and try new genres...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But are you sure we'll be able to get all the way through those movies?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If the subject matter is too complicated or not all that appealing, then we might have trouble following what happens.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, when you put it that way...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah, you're right.
We should go with something more familiar first!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: My thoughts exactly. Let's look together...
